title: Research: exact rational frame floor on four roles
body:
## Result

This package proves the exact paid-call minimum for one four-register target in a fixed torsion-free additive address model. The four rank-one rational addresses are `A`, `B`, `P`, and `Q=A+B-P`; the target is `diag([A+P],[A+Q],[B+P],[B+Q])`. A direct word uses eight calls. The augmentation-degree-one equations and a rank/trace-parity bound give a lower bound of eight for every word length and order, so no call saving is possible in this fixed alphabet.

The proof reduces to minimizing an exact integer expression over all 65,536 matrices in `M4(F2)`. The direct schedule is a positive control. A mutated target mask gives floor six, checking the final role bit. The registered package includes the certificate, source and predecessor pins, task record, overlap coverage, and verifier.

## Scope

The result counts paid rank-one frame calls with free binary role mixing. It is a local formal-model minimum, not a full bit-supplier implementation or a new selected `κ`. The complete provider, add/frame schedule and precision invoice remain outside this scope. The selected record and all frozen source inputs are unchanged.

The closest neighboring results are the four-role finite `F2[S3]` target in Discussion #2023 and the finite Klein-four target from Cycle 20; both use different address laws and targets. PRs #1974 and #2027 are also pinned as task predecessors.

## Reproduction

```sh
python3 -I -B research/bit-four-register-rational-frame-floor-seed3573e12e/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-four-register-rational-frame-floor-seed3573e12e --check-only
```

Expected mathematical verifier line:

```text
PASS_FOUR_REGISTER_RATIONAL_FRAME_EXACT_MINIMUM_8 projectors=120 paid_factors=480 relaxation_states=65536 min_floor=8 minimizers=64 direct_calls=8 mutated_floor=6
```

Both commands pass locally on Python 3.14.7. The generic registered replay requires Python 3.12, which is unavailable in this environment. Package metadata/source pins pass; this is not a maintainer review or supplier admission.
